palettes.name: Forest
palettes.description: Deep forest green and soft ivory. Grounded and understated.
palettes.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand, color-treatment edit.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: Astro90's selected lowercase wordmark and matching standalone a. It is a transparent PNG. Read its alpha correctly over a light background before interpreting the black lettering.
Task: present this same selected identity in one additional color palette. Preserve the original letter shapes, the single-storey a, the rounded-square counters, exact lowercase text, rounded s, spacing, proportions, weight and original 9 and 0. Do not invent a new typeface, change the s into a diagonal lightning form, narrow the counters, or add decorations. The only intentional changes are color and presentation placement.
Exact text: "astro90", seven characters a s t r o 9 0. The icon is the identical lowercase a extracted from the wordmark.
Finished presentation board: 1536x1024 landscape. Top two-thirds: a generous centered main wordmark with ample margins. Bottom third: a solid contrasting band with a smaller inverse wordmark and a square tile containing the standalone a. Precise visual alignment, identical lettering in all wordmarks. Crisp, flat graphic shapes with solid color fills.
CRITICAL: The board must be completely OPAQUE. Preserve both solid color background panels, including all blank space. Do not export transparency or remove backgrounds. This is a completed graphic presentation board, not a transparent logo export.
No extra text, palette labels, slogans, gradients, shadows, textures, glow, bevels, 3D, photography, objects or mockups.
Palette: forest green #163F35 and warm pale ivory #EEF1E7. Upper panel ivory with a forest-green main wordmark. Lower band forest green with the ivory wordmark; ivory square icon tile with forest-green a. The feeling is calm, assured, and independent.
